# TF-0569 Verse Tools and Harness Collaboration

> Agent-driven evidence. The harness executes work; VB, VS and VG retain their own authority.

## Results

| Scenario | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| VerseBrowser | pass 1/1 (66.9s) | real embedded browser: open -> observe -> act -> re-observe -> verify; private-network/forged-approval/unsupported negatives fail closed |
| VerseShell | pass 7/7 (2.98s, contract) | five-operation order, canonical mapping, closed schemas, frozen lifecycle inventory and owner routing |
| VerseGit diagnostics | pass 2/2 (22.2s) | frozen identity through renderer -> hostInvoke -> Main; binary mismatch rejected without spawning |
| VS real process | not-run | host sandbox denied lifecycle persistence: E_PROCESS_PERSIST |
| VG candidate apply | not-run | host sandbox denied bridge-events write (EPERM) / lifecycle persistence (E_PROCESS_PERSIST) |

## Boundary

- VB keeps browser session, private-network and approval authority; the harness cannot forge approval or switch drivers after a denial.
- VS keeps frozen argv, bounded output, timeout/cancel and receipt authority; the harness does not self-approve.
- VG provides workspace/session/candidate/advisory facts; it does not provide harness verdict, task completion, M4 landing/admission or Git apply.
- No VG M4, VS default-on or VB contract-count runtime claim was introduced.
- All evidence is agent-driven; no real-human evidence is claimed.
